tasks.short: Participate in recruitment, registration and placement

steps.what: Discuss study options and capture registration details supplied by prospective students
Populate registration paperwork with checked fields without deciding admission or placement
Check registration details, discuss placement questions and approve the record sent to authorised staff

tasks.design: Configure field reuse in the institution's registration functions represented by {LMS}. Conversations, placement judgement and approval of information sent to authorised staff remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Information from student discussions may be recopied into registration paperwork.
tasks.enabler_now: Native form fields can reuse checked information without assessing applicants.
tasks.still_hard: Understand a prospective student's goals and explain appropriate options.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise uncertainty and refer a consequential placement question to the right person.
tasks.altitude: Improve registration information quality while protecting individual advice.

reach.learn: Separate information gathering from admission authority

evidence.claim: Native registration forms can reuse supplied fields; the physics teacher participation scenario and savings are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: During s1 the student supplies identity, contact details and intended program; the teacher captures identifiers, requested term and exact supplied details. Discussion, capture and missing field resolution are included in 50 hours.
No admission, suitability or placement flag is produced by the form. Consequential decisions remain with authorised people in the existing process.
Native functions are checked first; unavailable mappings or unclear information return to manual preparation in s3.
Any existing student submission effort remains unchanged; the design does not shift new capture work to the student.
unknowns: Teacher's registration authority and current form reuse
research_questions: Does native field reuse save effort after student discussion and checking?

already_counted.description: Student discussion, capture, placement advice and information approval

incremental.description: Field mapping upkeep and registration reconciliation

approvals.approved_version: Exact student, program, term and registration details sent internally; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100, R=80 gives 20 gross and 13 net after 7 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-3 allows predominantly personal participation and existing registration tools.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on institutional and departmental committees

steps.what: Serve on committees by considering evidence, discussing alternatives and contributing to institutional decisions

tasks.design: Retain committee service as deliberation and shared judgement. Meeting transcription is not credited with replacing this decision work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Institutional matters require consideration of competing interests and accountability.
tasks.enabler_now: No task specific means of replacing the contribution is established.
tasks.still_hard: Reconcile academic priorities with practical institutional constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Understand colleagues' perspectives and challenge weak arguments.
tasks.altitude: Improve the evidence and clarity of committee decisions.

reach.learn: Make assumptions and trade offs explicit

evidence.claim: Committee deliberation remains human work; no labour saving is established for this task.

assumptions: The teacher reads, weighs and discusses evidence within s1; no ready made consensus or policy recommendation flag is assumed.
No secretarial work is invented as the baseline for committee service.
No additional deployment or operating process means upkeep is zero.
research_questions: Which evidence gaps repeatedly prevent a clear committee decision?

incremental.description: No added software or operating work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100: committee service remains fully counted, giving zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define the research proposal and capture call requirements, evidence, methods and budget assumptions
Draft grant proposal sections from the scientific plan and checked source brief

loop.purpose: Draft explanatory proposal wording without inventing scientific claims or commitments
loop.input: Author defined plan, exact call passages, selected evidence and budget assumptions
loop.output: Draft sections with source and requirement references
loop.check: Author verifies every scientific claim, citation, budget figure, commitment and call reference against the brief
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; missing support or invented claims return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use call forms and reusable approved sections first; draft only novel explanatory wording

steps.what: Check proposal coherence, verify commitments and finalise the version for institutional review

tasks.design: Use call forms and reusable sections in {DOCS}, with budget assumptions in {SPREADSHEET}, before bounded wording assistance. The researcher owns the science and final checked proposal; submission remains within the institution's existing approval process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Explaining a scientific plan in a call's format requires substantial drafting and revision.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can propose wording from a supplied scientific plan and evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Develop a credible research idea and make justified commitments.
tasks.human_edge: Know which claims are novel, uncertain or not yet supported.
tasks.altitude: Own scientific coherence and evidence quality.

reach.learn: Separate source supported claims from aspirational outcomes

evidence.claim: Bounded wording assistance may help proposal drafting, but scientific validity and task labour effects remain unmeasured E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: In s1 the researcher produces the scientific plan and captures exact call passages, section limits, source references, approved cost inputs and proposed commitments. Retrieval, capture and clarification are counted in 35 hours.
No eligibility or fundability flag is inferred. Tool use depends on the actual call and institutional handling rules; if unsuitable, write manually.
s2 retains 28 hours for assertion and citation checks and rewriting; s3 retains final coherence and commitment checks.
Institutional submission and authorisation remain outside this writing task and earn no savings. Additional support review is charged below.
unknowns: Applicable call rules and permitted handling environment
Share of novel prose versus reusable sections
research_questions: Does checked wording assistance reduce total proposal writing time without increasing unsupported claims?

already_counted.description: Scientific plan, brief capture, assertion review and final proposal checks

incremental.description: Source pack upkeep and sampled draft audit

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100, R=88 gives 12 gross and 6 net after 6 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-3 allows heavy scientific revision and call restrictions; no funding success effect is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select specialized reading materials and verify their bibliographic fields and student suitability
Format bibliographies and sort verified reading entries using the selected citation style
Check bibliography entries and access details and approve the reading list before student release

tasks.design: Configure citation style and bibliography fields in {DOCS}, then publish the teacher checked list through {LMS}. Selection and verification remain human; no model invents references.
tasks.previous_blocker: Verified reading references were repeatedly typed and formatted.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference functions can format supplied bibliographic fields consistently.
tasks.still_hard: Choose appropriate specialised reading and verify access to the correct version.
tasks.human_edge: Know which reading supports the students' understanding.
tasks.altitude: Own reading selection and reference accuracy.

evidence.claim: Native reference formatting can assemble checked bibliographic fields without generating citations; savings remain E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: In s1 the teacher selects publications and captures author, title, year, edition, publication details, identifier and access reference from the publication or library record. Selection, retrieval, manual capture and correction are included in 50 hours.
The teacher also selects citation style in s1. Missing metadata returns to manual verification; the formatter never fills it from memory.
Native document references or an existing reference manager are used before custom software. Existing automatic formatting yields zero additional saving.
Reading list work is assigned only here when it overlaps with course materials.
unknowns: Current reference tools and metadata completeness
research_questions: Does native bibliography formatting save time after source and access verification?

already_counted.description: Reading selection, metadata capture and publication checks

incremental.description: Style upkeep and sampled reference checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact bibliography entries, access references and course destination; edits invalidate approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100, R=70 yields 30 gross and 24 net after 6 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-8 allows existing reference management and substantial selection and metadata checking.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep academic judgement with the teacher while reducing repeated form entry, prose assembly and reference formatting.
reach: Help research support and library colleagues trace claims and references to their sources
role.ambitious_version: A physicist with reliable administrative artifacts and preserved time for scientific ideas, students and institutional judgement.
